alex: heads-up — multiple customers reporting p95/p99 regressions specifically on function-calling endpoints since last night. p95 ~2x, p99 ~5x. Suspect JSON schema validation step added in router PR. :eyes:

maria: which routes? any repro payloads or request ids?

alex: examples: POST /v1/call-tool with body including tool call + large nested args. quick curl to repro: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/call-tool -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"tool":"search","args":{"q":"long prompt...","metadata":{...}}}'``` logs: ```[router] recv req id=abc123; [validator] start; [validator] validate took=450ms; [tool-router] route took=230ms; total=700ms``` baseline before PR was ~120ms.

jordan: we saw a validator change that switched to full deep-schema validation (recursive) for tool args. It runs synchronously inside the router request path. That explains the jump.

sre-oncall: metric dump — spike aligns with deploy at 2026-03-16T03:14Z. p99 CPU on router nodes spiked, queuing increased. Quick check: 99th latency per route: call-tool: 1200ms -> 6.1s at peak.

maria: ok. short triage plan: 1) get repro traces + sample payloads from support 2) temporarily disable schema validation toggle for call-tool routes (config feature flag) 3) scale router pool by +30% while we patch validator to async or sampled validation. Support: can you collect 10 failed traces and share?

support-bot: escalation created: #INC-2026-314 (priority P1) — assigned to eng-runtime and SRE.

alex: attaching two sanitized payloads in thread, and a short trace showing stack: ```router->validator->deep-validate->json-schema::validate_item()``` showing a lot of recursion on nested metadata arrays.

jordan: short-term mitigations: a) flip feature flag to soft-validate (log-only) b) add fast-path: if schema hash in cache -> skip full validate c) increase router worker threads for tool-router group. Longer: move validation to async background service (accept request + run validation off-path; if invalid then enqueue rollback or closure). Also suggest sampling approach: validate 1% of calls for regression detection.

maria: I'm going to flip soft-validate for non-enterprise customers now and spin router instances. doing a canary rollback for the validator PR in 10m if metrics don't improve.

sre-oncall: scaled router pool +30% at 03:52Z. watching p95/p99 in realtime.

maria: rolled back the validator PR at 04:05Z (canary -> full). initial numbers: p95 dropped from ~1.8s to 220ms; p99 down to ~420ms. :thumbsup:

alex: confirmed with customer — latency back to baseline. leaving follow-up PR notes: implement cached-schema fast-path, add async-validator service, and add opt-out per-customer toggle. I'll write repro + perf testcases.

jordan: follow-ups I'll own: implement sample-validation and add a lightweight WASM validator to test perf.

support-bot: customer notifications queued: 3 affected customers will get status update.

maria: thanks all — filing postmortem and schedule a short sync tomorrow to go over design for async validation + rollout checklist.

alex: thanks, team.
